detail.longDescription: The first thing I do in the mornings before work is check my Google Calendar. It's my source of truth for whatever the day ahead holds, including team meetings, projects that need my attention, and even errands I need to fit in between. But even if you do use Google Calendar to organize your day, it can still be a real hustle to prioritize critical tasks when your schedule fills up fast.
